nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; set in the Owned constructor from msg.sender.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string (' GHOST SHIBA ').
Token name string ('ghostshiba.xyz').
Token decimals (8).
Total token supply; minted to owner in the constructor.
Anti-bot blacklist/limit address used to block transfers to a specific destination.
Mapping of address to token balance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved allowance.
Checked addition library function.
Checked subtraction library function with require(b <= a).
Checked multiplication library function.
Checked division library function with require(b > 0).
Constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Claim pending ownership; requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Constructor initialising token metadata and minting the entire supply to owner.
onlyOwner setter that assigns the newun blacklist/limit address, enabling transfer blocking.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances of address(0).
Returns the balance of a token holder.
Transfers tokens; requires to != newun, otherwise reverts with 'please wait'.
Sets an allowance for a spender.
Transfer on behalf of another address; mutates newun when from != 0 and newun == 0, otherwise requires to != newun.
Returns the remaining allowance for a spender.
Sets allowance and performs an external call to an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain Ether transfers.
onlyOwner function that drains the entire contract ETH balance to msg.sender.
Empty payable fallback that silently accepts Ether sent to the contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balances and as ETH recipient.
External ETH transfer of the whole contract balance to msg.sender inside clearCNDAO.
Unbounded external call to an attacker-supplied spender contract (receiveApproval) after state update.
require(to != newun) gate used in transfer/transferFrom that can be armed by the owner to block specific recipients.
Parameter of transferOwnership: the staged new owner address.
Parameter of transfer: recipient address checked against newun.
Parameter of transfer: amount of tokens moved.
Parameter of approve: address granted the allowance.
Parameter of approve: allowance amount.
Parameter of transferFrom: source address debited.
Parameter of transferFrom: destination address checked against newun.
Parameter of transferFrom: amount moved and allowance consumed.
Parameter of allowance: owner whose allowance is queried.
Parameter of allowance: spender whose allowance is queried.
Parameter of approveAndCall: arbitrary contract that receives receiveApproval.
Parameter of approveAndCall: allowance granted to the spender.
Parameter of approveAndCall: arbitrary calldata forwarded to the external call.
Parameter of transfernewun: address stored as the transfer block target.
Parameter of balanceOf: address whose balance is returned.
Local payable alias of msg.sender that receives the drained ETH.

edges.reason: _newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
transfer recipient parameter is used as the credited balance key.
transfer token amount parameter flows into SafeMath.sub/add balance updates.
transfer recipient parameter is checked against the newun gate.
approve spender parameter is the allowance mapping key.
approve token amount parameter is stored in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom from parameter is the debited balance and allowance key.
transferFrom to parameter is the credited balance key.
transferFrom destination parameter is validated against newun.
transferFrom amount parameter is subtracted from balance and allowance.
allowance tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
allowance spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
attacker-supplied spender parameter is the target of the approveAndCall external call.
approveAndCall token amount is stored as allowance and forwarded to the callee.
arbitrary data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
transfernewun parameter is stored in the newun blocking variable.
balanceOf tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
msg.sender is granted ownership in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
msg.sender balance is debited by transfer.
msg.sender is granted allowance and passed into the external receiveApproval call.
clearCNDAO is onlyOwner and uses msg.sender as the payout target.
contract balance is transferred to the caller address inside clearCNDAO.
owner-controlled msg.sender can arm the newun block through transfernewun.
clearCNDAO execution reaches the ETH drain operation.
local _owner is assigned msg.sender before the payout.
local _owner is the recipient of the full contract balance transfer.
approveAndCall execution reaches the external receiveApproval call.
external callee re-enters the token contract after allowance state has been written.
transfer conditionally reverts on the newun gate.
transferFrom conditionally reverts on the newun gate.
transferFrom may silently assign the caller-chosen recipient to newun.
transfernewun writes the newun state variable.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
transfer updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts the zero-address balance via SafeMath.sub.
constructor sets the initial _totalSupply.
constructor mints the whole supply into balances[owner].
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
constructor initialises the owner state variable.
transfer relies on SafeMath.sub/add for balance arithmetic.
transferFrom relies on SafeMath.sub/add for balance and allowance arithmetic.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter only exists to feed transferOwnership's state write and can be folded into that function.
The transfer recipient parameter is only meaningful as the argument of transfer.
The transfer amount parameter is only meaningful as the argument of transfer.
The approve spender parameter is only used inside approve.
The approve amount parameter is only used inside approve.
The transferFrom source parameter is only used inside transferFrom.
The transferFrom destination parameter is only used inside transferFrom.
The transferFrom amount parameter is only used inside transferFrom.
The allowance owner parameter is only used inside allowance.
The allowance spender parameter is only used inside allowance.
The approveAndCall spender parameter is the external call target and should be folded into approveAndCall.
The approveAndCall amount parameter is only used inside approveAndCall.
The approveAndCall data parameter is forwarded to the unsafe external call.
The transfernewun parameter is only used by the transfernewun owner setter.
The balanceOf holder parameter is only used inside balanceOf.
The local _owner alias is immediately used as the recipient of the unsafe ETH transfer.
